## Problem

What user or engineering problem does this solve?

## Change

Describe the resulting behavior and link the related issue (for example, Closes #123).

## Validation

- [ ] Backend tests and coverage pass.
- [ ] Frontend lint, formatting, tests, and build pass.
- [ ] Changed user flows have appropriate tests.
- [ ] README/API documentation matches the implementation.
- [ ] No credentials, generated dependencies, or private data are committed.

## Screenshots and limitations

Include screenshots for visible changes and note any remaining tradeoffs.
